Hi Alex —

Following up with the formal positions and proposed DPA language. Please find answers below (this email intended for your legal review):

1) Controller / Processor
- Redwood accepts the role of processor in our standard DPA when we process customer content on behalf of the customer (controller). We are open to clarifying joint responsibilities in specific sections if Sunrise requires it for certain integrations.

2) Subprocessors
- We maintain a current subprocessor list (cloud infra providers, observability vendors, and a small set of managed service partners). We will provide the current list as an attachment and commit to 30 days' notice for material changes. If Sunrise requires prior written consent for new subprocessors, we can add a notification period and an escalation path in Section 4.2.

3) Breach Notice
- Redwood's DPA language includes an obligation to notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming a breach affecting customer data; the notice will include scope, impacted systems, and mitigation steps. For highly regulated customers we can agree to additional contractual SLAs and escalation contacts.

4) Data Residency
- Hosted: default is US (us-east-1).
- EU option: we can pin your account to eu-west-1 (data residency guarantee) — typical provisioning time: 2–4 weeks.
- Dedicated / Private: on-prem or customer-managed region possible; we'll include those options in the commercial addendum.

5) Data Retention & Logs
- Default request/response logs: 90 days.
- KV/prefix cache ephemeral by default; persisted caches are retained per customer config.
- Customers can request custom retention windows for logs and observability data under Dedicated/Private plans; we'll add configurable options to the DPA appendix.

6) PII handling & Redaction
- We offer integrations for field-level redaction and tokenization. For sensitive PHI/PII use-cases, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments plus customer-managed keying (KMS/HSM).

Attachments: current_subprocessor_list.pdf (see SharePoint link below). If your legal team prefers, we can provide tracked DPA redlines.

- Draft DPA (tracked): https://redwoodinference.sharepoint.com/sunrise/dpa-tracked
